result.title: LoopKV: Loop-Aware KV Cache Compression for Serving Looped Transformers
result.summary: Looped transformers apply a shared block several times per token to improve accuracy without adding parameters. For models such as Ouro that keep a separate key-value (KV) cache per loop, cache memory limits the batch size that amortizes repeated weight reads. Uniform-bit quantization and fixed rules per loop do not allocate precision according to each layer's sensitivity in each loop. Measurements on Ouro show that quantization sensitivity varies across (loop, layer) cells, and the sum of individual cell damages approximates the overall output damage. Sharing damage also varies by cell, with later loops generally tolerating sharing better. Skipping low-attention values to save reads produces errors that compound across loops. LoopKV uses a one-time offline profile to choose 4-bit storage, 2-bit storage or reuse of the final loop's KV for each cell. The planner minimizes reads under budgets for predicted damage and storage. During decoding, each loop reads the high 2 bits of each 4-bit value and fetches the low bits only where its own attention weights require 4-bit precision. A single fused kernel in vLLM executes the plan. Serving Ouro-1.4B on one RTX PRO 6000, the memory-optimized LoopKV-M plan stores 35% less KV than uniform 4-bit quantization (KIVI-4) on the same fused kernel and CUDA graph. It sustains 1.7-2.2x KIVI-4's goodput under a latency service-level objective with a 16K-token maximum length. None of its averages on six public benchmarks falls significantly below BF16's.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 Ouro 等 looped transformer 每轮独立 KV cache 的内存瓶颈，提出 LoopKV：离线逐「循环—层」单元画像量化敏感度，规划 4-bit、2-bit 或复用末轮 KV 的混合方案，并在解码时按各轮注意力需求动态取低位比特，由 vLLM 单个融合 kernel 执行。
AI.relevance_reason: 逐「循环—层」精度分配与跨轮 KV 复用，可能为 latent 循环推理中状态保留、压缩及缓存结构如何影响表示相似度提供可供核查的方法线索，但原文目标仅为服务效率，未涉及推理内容的语义使用。
